summary: Ansible 15 community.general deprecates its redirects (removed in 18.0.0) for Dell iDRAC/OME (dellemc.openmanage), Docker (community.docker), Google Cloud (community.google), HashiCorp Vault (community.hashi_vault), Hetzner (community.hrobot), Kubevirt (community.kubevirt) and NIOS (infoblox.nios_modules) content.
questions: Which collection should I use for hashi_vault lookups?
When will community.general redirects be removed?

answer_card.title: Update old community.general redirect names
answer_card.answer_md:
Redirects from community.general to these collections are deprecated and go away in community.general 18.0.0, so use the target FQCN directly:

- Dell iDRAC/OME: `dellemc.openmanage`
- Docker: `community.docker`
- Google Cloud: `community.google`
- HashiCorp Vault: `community.hashi_vault`
- Hetzner: `community.hrobot`
- Kubevirt: `community.kubevirt`
- NIOS: `infoblox.nios_modules`
